TAKANO Noriyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	acquire the ability to perform basic numerical programming.
(2)	acquire the ability to utilize branch and repetition processing.
(3)	understand the types of variables and how they are handled in the computer.
advice:
This is a basic course on numerical analysis. We will cover the following topics:

1.	Computer literacy
2.	Algorithms and Flowcharts
3.	Input and output
4.     Variables and Types ( internal representation in computers)
5.     Sequential  processing
6.	Branch processing
7.	Repetition processing
8.     Function
books: How to Create Programs: An Introduction to Python Lv.0 (in Japanese)

activityGoals.body: Be able to draw a shape using a turtle
Be able to write code using repetition process
Be able to write code using branch processs
Be able to create a simple game code
Be able to explain types of variables and their internal representation

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Able to create code that draws complex figures
(2) Able to create code with multiple repetitions
(3) Able to create code with four or more branches
(4) Able to create original games
(5) Able to explain the internal representation of variables
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Able to draw simple figures
(2) Able to write code to calculate the sum of natural numbers from 1 to 100
(3) Able to write code to process a single conditional expression according to its truth or false.
(4)	Able to create simple game code
(5)	Able to explain types of variables
